BEHIND THE NUMBERS
Same price. A different lens.
01
Standard follows the pool

A geometric mean of price over time. Every recorded tick contributes, including sharp moves.

02
Truncated limits each step

Tick movement is capped at 9,116 per observation. Sudden moves have a smaller immediate effect; the series can still drift.

03
History grows with activity

The hook records the pre-swap tick at most once per timestamp. Slot capacity is not a count of filled observations or a time guarantee.
